rv.q: Finally, and not before time, he's decided to work on a masterpiece and the results are thrilling indeed.
Pillars and all, this “Woods” is lovely, dark and deep — and worth the journey.
Kokandy Productions’ show, directed and tightly choreographed by Derek Van Barham, meets the demands of this funny and inventive book by Lapine, with music and lyrics by Sondheim.
The vocal work is quite dazzling.
This production, thanks to some great performances, excellent singing and Derek Van Barham’s wise direction, will touch the heart and charm the child out of any cynical grownup.
This show would be worth seeing for the piano performances alone.
This is the production to see to properly end 2024!
A flawless production skillfully brought to fruition and worth the trip to the Chopin Theatre.
